closeHtml: RS Bill@Edge™ transforms it into real-time payment infrastructure—reducing operational complexity, accelerating cash flow, and enabling institutions to turn billing into a strategic, revenue-impacting capability.

regions.introTitleHtml: Every bill. Every participant. Every market.
regions.introHtml:
Payment rails have evolved, but the bill payment journey often remains fragmented across invoices, biller portals, payment channels and reconciliation systems. RS Bill@Edge™ brings these pieces together through a unified, API-first platform for bill presentment and Request for Payment (RfP)-led bill payments.

From invoice generation and presentment to payment orchestration, servicing, reconciliation and intelligence, RS Bill@Edge™ manages the complete invoice-to-action lifecycle across payment infrastructures and market models.
regions.whyHtml: RS Bill@Edge™ is rail-agnostic and deployment-model agnostic, allowing it to sit above existing payment infrastructure as an orchestration and experience layer or operate as a switch where required. Its four-party model connects billers, biller banks, payer banks and customers through one governed, traceable lifecycle.

caps.descHtml: Ingest, validate and normalize invoices from ERPs, bulk files, biller portals and APIs.
Give customers a consolidated bill inbox with GenAI-powered summaries.
Generate and orchestrate structured Request for Payment messages.
Enable customers to pay immediately, later or on a scheduled basis.
Support recurring payments with configurable mandate lifecycle controls.
Connect payment processing, reconciliation and real-time status visibility.
Use payment certainty scoring, exception prediction and next-best-action insights.

regions.introTitleHtml: From BBPS-scale infrastructure to the next generation of bill payments.
regions.introHtml:
India has already demonstrated what happens when bill payments move from fragmented channels to a unified ecosystem. RS Bill@Edge™ powers the Bharat Bill Payment System (BBPS), established by NPCI, connecting consumers, banks, fintechs and billers through a nationwide bill presentment and payment environment.

Building on this experience, RS Bill@Edge™ brings biller onboarding, invoice generation, presentment, payment, reconciliation, complaints, disputes, and refunds into one connected lifecycle.
regions.whyTitleHtml: Built around the scale and operational complexity of Indian bill payments
regions.whyHtml:
From BBPS and NPCI-led bill payment infrastructure to the day-to-day needs of banks, billers and agents, RS Bill@Edge™ combines the operational controls, automation, and visibility needed to manage a large bill payment ecosystem.

Accelerate biller onboarding with AI-assisted payload mapping that identifies field matches and gaps for operator review, turning a configuration process that once took weeks into 1–2 working days. Configurable dashboards bring fetch, validation, payment, status, settlement, and dispute metrics into one view, while AI-assisted layouts, agent and geography heat maps, and COU/BOU dashboards help teams monitor performance, identify inactive agents, and improve operational and cost control.

caps.descHtml: Simplify biller onboarding, configuration and participant management through a structured, configuration-driven process.
Generate and convert invoices into structured digital payment journeys.
Support consolidated bill views and digital bill presentment across channels.
Convert invoices into Request for Payment messages for structured collections.
Connect consumer-bank payment gateways with biller-side processing for reconciliation.
Manage complaints, disputes and refund workflows within the bill payment lifecycle.
Support transaction search, notifications, custom MIS reporting and downtime notifications.
Track payment status and settlement activity across the bill payment lifecycle.

regions.closingHtml: From AI-assisted onboarding to operational intelligence, RS Bill@Edge™ helps make India's bill payment ecosystem easier to configure, monitor and manage.

regions.introTitleHtml: Built for a payment environment moving toward real-time, data-rich payments.
regions.introHtml:
As Canada moves toward the Payments Canada Real-Time Rail (RTR) and ISO 20022-based payment infrastructure, bill payment can become more than a payment instruction; it can become a connected, data-rich customer journey.

RS Bill@Edge™ provides an API-first bill presentment and Request for Payment layer that can sit above payment infrastructure, connecting billers, biller banks, payer banks and customers through a governed invoice-to-payment lifecycle.
regions.whyTitleHtml: Bring bill presentment and RfP into Canada's evolving payment ecosystem
regions.whyHtml: With ISO 20022 at the centre of Canada's modern payment infrastructure, RS Bill@Edge™ provides structured bill presentment and RfP orchestration while maintaining flexibility across infrastructure models.

caps.descHtml: Create structured Request for Payment journeys aligned with data-rich payment environments.
Position bill presentment and RfP orchestration above evolving real-time payment infrastructure.
Bring invoices into the customer's banking experience instead of fragmented biller channels.
Support immediate, later and scheduled payment choices.
Manage recurring payments with configurable mandate lifecycle controls.
Provide closed-loop acknowledgement and status visibility across participants.
Automate matching and connect biller and bank-side payment information.
Expose platform capabilities through APIs, ISO 20022-compliant endpoints and a dedicated sandbox.

regions.introTitleHtml: Bring RFP-led bill payments and everyday payment choices into one connected journey.
regions.introHtml:
The U.S. payment ecosystem spans FedNow® RFP, ACH, cards, wallets, bank transfers and other local payment channels. RS Bill@Edge™ provides a rail-agnostic bill payment layer that connects invoice creation and presentment with Request for Payment, flexible payment options, reconciliation and payment visibility.

For SMBs and gig workers, the platform also brings mobile-first invoice creation and AI-assisted drafting into the payment journey.
regions.whyTitleHtml: Give every U.S. invoice a clearer path to payment
regions.whyHtml: Whether a customer pays through a banking app using Request for Payment, or chooses cards, wallets, bank transfers or other local payment methods, RS Bill@Edge™ connects the invoice to the payment experience while giving the biller visibility into what happens next.

caps.descHtml: Turn invoices into digital Request for Payment journeys, including use cases aligned with RFP-enabled real-time payment environments.
Support banking apps, cards, wallets, bank transfers and local payment rails.
Enable SMBs and gig workers to create professional invoices directly from their phones.
Generate invoices from plain-language input and reduce the effort involved in billing.
Deliver invoices through digital channels and create a connected view-and-act experience.
Track paid, pending and overdue invoices through a connected status view.
Connect payment processing with reconciliation and biller-confirmed acknowledgement.
Use payment certainty scoring and next-best-action insights to support more predictable collections.

regions.introTitleHtml: As Nordic payment ecosystems become increasingly instant and interoperable, the bill should be just as easy to act on.
regions.introHtml: Across the Nordic region, payment ecosystems are aligning around NPC Instant Credit Transfer and SEPA Instant standards and increasingly digital customer experiences. RS Bill@Edge™ brings that same focus to bill payments, combining digital bill presentment, Request for Payment, flexible payment journeys and intelligent bill experiences.
regions.whyTitleHtml: Turn the Nordic digital payment experience into a smarter bill payment journey
regions.whyHtml: For customers accustomed to digital, account-based payment experiences, RS Bill@Edge™ turns complex invoices into simple actions with a smart bill inbox, GenAI summaries, flexible payment choices and closed-loop confirmation.

caps.descHtml: Bring bills from multiple billers into one consolidated digital view.
Surface what is due, what has changed and what needs action.
Provide a rail-agnostic bill payment layer that can operate above existing payment infrastructure.
Turn invoices into structured digital payment requests.
Support pay-now, pay-later and scheduled payment journeys.
Enable recurring payments with the ability to set up, pause, resume or modify mandates.
Keep customers informed and close the loop with biller-confirmed payment acknowledgement.
Manage corrections, refunds, reversals, disputes and exceptions within one governed lifecycle.
